### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/42791

Problem Summary:

- Change the total retry time from 600ms to 2s.
-  Update logs.
- Add `MockDisableDistTask` to stop the dispatcher in the domain.

- Besides, clean up the cache in the test.

```
    dispatcher_test.go:212: 
        	Error Trace:	disttask/framework/dispatcher/dispatcher_test.go:21
        	            				disttask/framework/dispatcher/dispatcher_test.go:248
        	Error:      	Not equal: 
        	            	expected: 0
        	            	actual  : 1
        	Test:       	TestParallelNormalFlow
```

### What is changed and how it works?
